 Order

This is sixth application under Section 483 of BNSS filed on behalf of the applicant in connection with Crime No.487/2021 registered at Police Station - Barwaha, district Khargone (M.P.) under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B/34 of IPC.
2.
The present application is filed mainly on the ground of delay in trial.

It is argued that applicant is in jail since 7.09.2021 and on the ground of delay, this Court has already allowed the bail application of co-accused Arvind vide order dated 28.1.2025 passed in M.Cr.C.NO. 53512/2024 and applicant is claiming parity with co-accused Arvind.
3.
In the case of Arvind, status report was called from the trial court and as per status report, out of 44 witnesses only 16 witnesses have been examined and delay is attributed to the prosecution.

4. Considering the order passed in the case of co-accused Arvind and NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:3157 2 MCRC-5455-2025 the fact that applicant in the present case is in jail since 7.9.2021 and there is no specific progress in the trial and delay in trial is attributed to the prosecution, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
